context: Extract the resource-claim and dispatch transaction from PR 6 after the team and Git writer contracts have landed. Validate all candidates and claims before mutating any team member, then commit the complete dispatch in one registry transaction. Decision gate: stop if dispatch can partially admit workers, if an expired holder can write after a successor acquires a new fence, or if release can succeed without matching owner, token, and evidence.
description: Prevent simultaneous or stale writers from using the same logical resource and make team dispatch all-or-nothing. Claims must carry an owner and monotonically changing fence token, expire into reconcile-required state, and release only with matching ownership and live evidence. This item does not add reviewer acceptance or cleanup orchestration.

anti_patterns.dont: Check claim availability and insert membership in separate transactions
anti_patterns.instead: Prevalidate and commit the complete dispatch atomically
anti_patterns.why: A competing supervisor can interleave and create duplicate writers

anti_patterns.dont: Release an expired claim based only on wall-clock time
anti_patterns.instead: Require matching owner, fence, and non-empty reconciliation evidence
anti_patterns.why: The holder or external resource may still be live

anti_patterns.instead: Fence the smallest canonical resource key
anti_patterns.why: It defeats legitimate parallel work on non-overlapping resources

preserves.behavior: Concurrent duplicates remain rejected, while a later non-overlapping failed-review retry can be admitted after evidence-backed release.
Expired claims become reconcile-required rather than silently available.
Only the current owner and fence can renew, write, or release a claim.
